item: Row J J2: every gate that states independence, coordination or convergence counts OUTLETS (a domain), not feeds; every other distinct-source count is classified; per-host work runs once per outlet
summary: With a source keyed on (domain, feed), two feeds of one site would have read as two independent voices. 14 gates now count the outlet (the domain; its label is the OLDEST source's name, so persisted actor signatures keep their meaning). A default-deny AST test classifies every distinct(source_id) and set-of-source_id site as outlet-level or feed-level with a reason (a new unlisted site fails); user-visible feed-level counts carry the sentence that they count feeds. Crawl candidate selection, archive backfill and the first-run preflight do their per-host work once per outlet per pass. The laundering, propagation and convergence texts and the feeds sentence are keyed x12.
